_authored: the shape an attempt artefact must have, derived from every path the consumers under scripts/corpus actually dereference (AST sweep) and typed by hand
_why: Five rounds closed this boundary one level at a time: first the envelope was unchecked, then the envelope was checked and its contents trusted. A malformed value nested one level below a valid mapping validated true and crashed the consumer that read it. The schema is total: every path a consumer dereferences is listed with its type, validation is recursive, and a mismatch makes the artefact unparseable rather than a crash three frames later.
_pin: no consumer may dereference a path absent from this schema (AST pin, with a negative control that the pin sees an added path)
_array_items: An array's ELEMENTS are typed here, and the types are READ FROM REAL ARTEFACTS, not assumed: limitations carries strings (196 observed), while claimed_facts, drivers, paths, confirmed_structure, subject_resolution.committed and .candidates carry mappings. Typing limitations as objects by analogy rejected 113 of 118 real attempts and would have shipped a scoring regression -- the array types must be measured like any other fact about the data.
_types_are_measured: Every type here is the type OBSERVED in 425 real artefacts, not inferred from a name or from a crash report. Two entries were typed by analogy in the first draft and both were wrong -- limitations carries strings, structure_needs is a mapping -- and together they rejected 233 of 425 real attempts, which would have shipped as a scoring regression. Types are a fact about the data and are measured like one.
_element_nodes: An array whose `element_node` names a schema node has EVERY element checked against that node. Typing `candidates` as an array of objects stopped one level above the fields the vector-basis derivation reads, which is the same shallow-boundary class r9 found at #1 and #2. `confidence` is `number` because 83 of 1201 are ints and 1118 are floats -- measured, not assumed.
_committed_not_element_typed: subject_resolution.committed is typed `array of object` but its ELEMENTS are deliberately NOT checked against committed_subject. Doing so rejects an artefact carrying an explicit null kind, and the row then scores agree_weak through the unreadable-artefact cap instead of the disagree it earns as a subject substitution -- doubt making a failed row look BETTER, which is the exact class this instrument already fixed once. r9 #1's repro (committed: [1]) is caught by the `items` check without element typing. The candidates array IS element-typed because the vector-basis derivation dereferences its fields and nothing there is nullable in any of the 425 measured artefacts.
